entities.name: PMID:25081341
observations: National Cancer Data Base cohort: among 14,627 women aged ≤45 with stage I–II breast cancer (2004–2006; median follow-up 6.1 years), adjusted OS did not improve with CPM overall (HR 0.93, p=0.39) or in ER-negative patients (HR 1.12, p=0.32).
Observational, adjusted analysis; authors called for longer follow-up.

entities.name: PMID:25047478
observations: SEER cohort of unilateral breast cancer patients treated 1998–2010 found apparent CPM-associated DSS (HR 0.86) and OS (HR 0.76) benefits; authors concluded this likely reflected selection bias, as contralateral cancer prevention did not explain the association.

entities.name: PMID:30607124
observations: Population-based cohort of 614 women aged ≤35; breast-cancer-specific mortality was similar with and without CPM, with no observed mortality improvement from CPM.
